# NEAR Private OTC

> Private OTC deal board on NEAR testnet. Public board shows pair, side, size band and expiry only. Exact terms and counter-offers are sealed to an OutLayer TEE enclave and revealed only to signed-in parties. Matching NEP-413 signed token_diff intents settle atomically via execute_intents on a NEAR Intents verifier (otcdesk-intents.testnet).

## Key facts
- Verifier: otcdesk-intents.testnet (near/intents defuse v0.4.2 release wasm)
- Relayer: otcdesk.testnet
- Tokens: otcdesk-usdc.testnet (tUSDC), otcdesk-eth.testnet (tETH), wrap.testnet (wNEAR)
- Enclave: OutLayer project otcdesk-enclave.testnet/private-otc, pubkey 03312dd677a5864ffc8cff352b7419b90896c9aee20e4f79308c1106517a4947e8
- Sign-in: Privy (email or Google) → NEAR implicit account
